subject: Cannot login after password reset
description: I reset my password yesterday and now I cannot login with the new password. The system says password incorrect even though I'm entering it correctly. I've tried clearing browser cache and using incognito mode but still getting the same error.

subject: Invoice charged twice for monthly subscription
description: I was charged twice for my monthly subscription on July 1st. I have two identical charges of $49.99 on my credit card statement. I only have one active subscription and should not have been charged twice.

subject: Feature request: dark mode support
description: Our team would love to see a dark mode option in the application. We work late hours and the bright interface causes eye strain. Many competitors offer this feature and it would greatly improve our experience.

subject: App crashes when uploading large files
description: Every time I try to upload a file larger than 50MB the application crashes completely. I get an error message saying memory allocation failed. This prevents me from uploading important project documents.

subject: Two-factor authentication not working
description: I enabled 2FA on my account but now I cannot login. The authenticator app generates codes but the system says they are invalid. I've tried re-enabling 2FA multiple times without success.

subject: API endpoint returns 500 error intermittently
description: The /api/users endpoint returns a 500 error approximately 30% of the time. When it works the response time is good but the intermittent failures are causing issues in our integration.

subject: Cannot access account from new device
description: I recently got a new laptop and cannot login to my account. The system seems to require some verification but I never received any verification email despite requesting it multiple times.

subject: Refund request for canceled subscription
description: I canceled my subscription last week but was still charged for this month. Please issue a refund for the unused portion. I need this processed quickly as I'm switching to a competitor.

subject: Database connection timeout errors
description: We get connection timeout errors every morning around 10 AM UTC. The issue lasts for about 15-20 minutes and then resolves itself. This is affecting our batch processing jobs.

subject: Feature request: bulk user import
description: We manage hundreds of users and would like a feature to bulk import users via CSV file instead of manually adding them one by one. This would save us significant time.

subject: Email notifications not being received
description: I have email notifications enabled in my settings but I'm not receiving any notification emails. Other team members are receiving theirs fine so the issue seems specific to my account.

subject: Export feature not working correctly
description: When I try to export data to CSV the file generated is corrupted and cannot be opened. The export button seems to hang for 30 seconds before completing.

subject: Unable to change account email address
description: I need to change my email address associated with my account but the settings page shows an error message: Invalid request. I've tried this from multiple devices and browsers.

subject: Performance degradation after recent update
description: Since the update on June 28th the application has been very slow. Loading times have increased from 2 seconds to 10+ seconds. Previous version worked fine.

subject: Feature request: custom dashboard widgets
description: It would be great if we could create custom dashboard layouts with different widgets. Currently the dashboard is fixed and doesn't meet all our monitoring needs.

subject: Cannot accept team invitation
description: My manager sent me a team invitation but I never received the invitation email. I also cannot find any way to manually join the team in the application.

subject: Third-party integration failing intermittently
description: Our Slack integration works sometimes but often fails to post notifications. Error logs show timeout errors when trying to connect to Slack webhook.

subject: Billing discrepancy in usage-based pricing
description: According to my calculations I should have been charged for 1000 API calls but the invoice shows 1500. Can someone review the billing and provide a breakdown of charges?

subject: Feature request: SSO integration
description: We would like to integrate our company's Active Directory with your platform using SSO. This would simplify user management for our IT team.

subject: Forgotten password reset link expired
description: I clicked the password reset link from my email but got an error saying the link has expired. The email only arrived 2 minutes before I clicked it.

subject: Entire account locked after failed login attempts
description: After entering the wrong password a few times my entire account got locked. I can see the message but there's no clear way to unlock it or request an unlock.

subject: Transactions not appearing in reports
description: I processed several transactions yesterday but they're not showing up in today's reports. The transactions are in the system but excluded from the reporting view.

subject: Mobile app crashes on launch
description: The mobile app crashes immediately when I try to launch it. I've tried reinstalling and it still doesn't work. The web version works fine.

subject: Subscription renewal failed but not notified
description: My subscription auto-renewal failed yesterday due to an expired credit card but I received no notification about it. I only found out when I tried to access the service.

subject: API rate limiting too restrictive
description: Our integration hits the API rate limit after just a few hundred calls. We need higher limits or a better rate limiting strategy to meet our use case.

subject: Data loss after accidental deletion
description: I accidentally deleted an important folder containing months of data. There's no trash or undo function. Is there any way to recover this data?

subject: Feature request: advanced filtering options
description: The current filtering options are too basic for our needs. We need regex support and compound filters to properly search our large datasets.

subject: Cannot see recent messages in chat
description: Messages sent in the last 24 hours are not visible in the chat window. Older messages load fine. This is affecting our team communication.

subject: Billing contact change not saved
description: I updated the billing contact email address in settings but when I check again it's reverted to the old address. My changes never seem to persist.

subject: Feature request: scheduled reports
description: We'd love the ability to schedule reports to be generated and emailed on a regular basis like weekly or monthly without manual intervention.

subject: Permission denied errors for shared resources
description: When my teammate shares a document with me I get permission denied errors when trying to access it. The sharing settings seem broken.

subject: Invoice not received for last month
description: I haven't received an invoice for my last month's charges. I need this invoice for accounting purposes. Can you please resend it?

subject: Search functionality returns incomplete results
description: When searching for items with specific tags the search sometimes misses results that should be included. The filtering logic seems inconsistent.

subject: Feature request: API documentation improvements
description: The current API documentation is outdated and doesn't match the actual API behavior. Examples would be very helpful for developers.

subject: Authentication token expiration too frequent
description: Our authentication tokens expire every 15 minutes which is very inconvenient. A longer expiration time or the ability to configure this would be better.

subject: Unable to process refunds for customers
description: The refund function in the admin panel throws an error for every refund I attempt. Our customer service team cannot process any refunds right now.

subject: Feature request: webhook support
description: We'd like to use webhooks to integrate with our third-party systems. Currently we're stuck using polling which is inefficient.

subject: Timezone settings not working correctly
description: I changed my timezone to EST but the application still displays times in UTC. This is causing confusion with our scheduling.

subject: Cannot download financial reports
description: The download button for financial reports doesn't work. I need these reports for tax preparation and cannot access them.

subject: Feature request: mobile app offline mode
description: The mobile app doesn't work offline at all. We need at least basic offline access to view data when traveling without internet.

subject: Duplicate user accounts created by mistake
description: Two duplicate accounts were accidentally created for the same user during system migration. Can these be merged or should I delete one?

subject: Email notification spam from system
description: I'm receiving too many automated email notifications and cannot find a way to disable them. Settings seem to have no effect on notification frequency.

subject: Feature request: role-based access control improvements
description: The current RBAC system is limited. We need more granular permissions for our larger organization structure.

subject: Cannot reset account security settings
description: I want to change my security settings including recovery phone and email but the settings page gives an error when I try to save changes.

subject: API goes down during peak hours without notice
description: Every evening around 6 PM the API becomes unavailable for 10-30 minutes without any warning or maintenance notification. This breaks our automated processes.

subject: Feature request: advanced analytics dashboard
description: We need more detailed analytics showing user behavior trends usage patterns and system health metrics.

subject: Storage quota exceeded unexpectedly
description: My account is showing as over quota but my file count is well under the limit. It seems storage is being miscalculated or there are hidden files consuming space.

subject: Feature request: batch operations API
description: A batch API endpoint that allows multiple operations in a single request would significantly improve our workflow efficiency.

subject: Data export contains corrupted Unicode characters
description: When I export data to JSON the Unicode characters are corrupted and unreadable. This breaks our downstream processing.

subject: Session timeout too short for long operations
description: The session times out while I'm performing long-running operations. I need to extend the session timeout limit for operational tasks.
